notes.title: Patch #7 (Cut The Fluff!) - Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
After looking at a majority of feedback I've done a few changes to make the game and experience much nicer. 
A lot of feedback was that, it was annoying to try get all the endings due to doing the same thing over and over again. 
So here is what has been done to remedy this. 

The main 3 endings are ending 1-3

When you don't have any of the main 3 endings - The first time you play the game it will be a standard playthrough. However, the notes will not appear.

When you have 1 of the main 3 endings - The second time you play it will play much like the first time but there is a much lower delay between events. This will make sure things happen much quicker.
The notes will now start appearing also.

When you have 2 of the main 3 endings - The game will run more like the demo version of the game, cutting most of the content and keeping a fast pace. 

When you have all main 3 endings - Once you have all main 3 endings and have played ending 4, the game will randomize between the 'Normal' shift and the 'Demo Like' shift.

Additional Fixes

Fixed - Secret Ending still happening during ending 5 if both triggered.
Fixed - Door speed after Ghost Hand scene.
Fixed - When speed of events happen.

notes.title: Patch #5 - Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
There hasn't been any major fixes on this patch. 

One major change however, is that the time of waiting for a next event to happen has been reduced. This means you'll have less waiting time for the next event to happen.
Over time the game will get quicker as the main game progresses.

notes.title: Patch #4 - Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
The following fixes are included in this patch.


Fixed - Game starting on Event 11. Has been set back to event 1 and times should be fixed.
Fixed - Sizeable window when in window mode.
Fixed - Being able to exit the booth sometimes when you're not suppose to.


Additional Changes

The bloody hands event near the end of the game will show up the first time you play the game then after that it will be RNG based so it's less frequent.
